problem_type: Semantic editing capabilities are registered only on the internal Pi surface
symptom: An MCP client cannot discover or invoke timeline, media, or export inspection tools even though the renderer capability targets already exist.
direct_cause: MCP capability projection registers only the canvas.read adapter and the MCP protocol routes only canvas.read through verified project-session transport.
class_root: Capability contracts do not have a single explicit, verified surface adapter for each externally reachable intent.
affected_population: MCP clients using an open Nomi project
entry_points: MCP stdio loopback RPC when the GUI is open
internal_only_reason: The invariant is an application-owned capability projection and lease routing rule.
invariants: Every MCP editing call has a transport-minted leaseHandle and is verified against the requested project and required scope before renderer execution.
Only explicit module-owned adapters can appear in MCP tools/list.
Paid export start/cancel remain host-only; status and verify are read-only projections.
Model-facing descriptors contain semantic intent names and never the retired editing aliases.
generality_proof: All editing callers converge on the capability contract registry and the MCP adapter resolver; enforcing explicit adapter identity, lease verification, and operation-level exposure there prevents another alias or future surface from bypassing the same boundary.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Allow-list explicit semantic MCP adapters and derive schemas/results from canonical contracts.
Verify project-session transport claims before forwarding an MCP editing request to the renderer.
Reject unbound bearer access to session-bound editing methods.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: GUI and headless routes share the MCP resolver and the project-session binding.
Tool discovery and argument validation are centralized before invokeForRequest.

recurrence.reason: Adding a new capability contract alone does not expose it to MCP; another contract can repeat the same silent absence.

prevention.invariant: Only frozen, module-owned adapters with explicit projection metadata are listed.
prevention.failure_mode: Unregistered, internal-only, or malformed adapters remain undiscoverable and cannot be invoked.
prevention.strategy: Keep the MCP resolver as the single allow-list and make the RPC route accept only its session-bound capability methods.

legacy_paths.rationale: The model surface uses the semantic editing manifest; old descriptors remain only as internal capability aliases until their adapter migration is complete.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls the reachability invariant.

migration: Existing Pi aliases continue through internal capability adapters; MCP clients migrate by discovering the four semantic names from tools/list.
residual_risks: Renderer reachability and real GUI approval walkthrough remain required after the unit contract is green.
Host-only export start/cancel are intentionally not model-authored MCP operations.
